values: Completed work through Android release 1.0.28 (31), including the three latest reliability fixes.
Refreshed cards, typography, spacing, navigation, and devotional colors across the app.
A cleaner and more consistent experience on Android and iOS.
Long supporting copy was removed where a clear section heading already communicates the purpose.
Screens are easier to scan and feel less crowded.
Users can change the visual theme from the app.
Comfortable viewing in bright and low-light settings.
Footer labels and icons use high-contrast colors in dark mode.
Daily Sacred Practice moved above streak
The primary daily action appears before continuity statistics.
Users reach the daily routine faster.
Yesterday streak hidden for first-time users
The previous-day indicator is omitted until the user has relevant history.
New users are not shown misleading streak data.
Previous Sadguru Maharaj wording was replaced throughout relevant app sections.
Attribution is consistent with the approved name.
The Hindi devotional-store wording was updated to Satsang Samigri.
The label matches the requested terminology.
Only the quote assigned to the current date is presented as the daily quote.
Users receive a focused daily teaching.
Newly uploaded quotes fill upcoming dates in sequence.
Administrators can prepare many days of content in advance.
Quotes move into the archive after their scheduled day.
Shared links carry a quote identifier and route the installed app to that quote.
Recipients land directly on the intended teaching.
Shared quote links provide Google Play and App Store destinations when the app is unavailable.
Recipients can install the correct app for their device.
Quote sharing includes branded text, attribution, and a web/deep link.
Shared content is recognizable and actionable.
Quote likes are stored and included in analytics.
Users can drag the playback position backward or forward.
Listeners can repeat or skip to a chosen part.
Aarti playback supports direct position seeking.
Users have consistent controls across audio sections.
Key navigation and app lifecycle events are recorded in Firebase.
The team can understand adoption and screen usage.
Actual satsang and aarti playback time is recorded.
The admin portal can report real listening engagement.
Meditation starts, elapsed time, and successful completions are tracked.
The team can compare intent with completed practice.
Wisdom interactions are captured as structured events.
The team can see which content users value.
A responsive Firebase-hosted admin page is protected by administrator email/password authentication.
Authorized staff can manage the app from a phone or browser.
The portal shows what each user did and when.
Support and engagement review can be user-specific.
Aggregate totals, seven-day activity, and activity breakdowns are visualized.
Overall app usage is understandable at a glance.
Administrators can add, edit, schedule, and review quote content.
Daily wisdom can be maintained without an app release.
Database access rules protect administration and user activity data.
The privacy page documents app activity collection and its operational purpose.
Users and reviewers receive clearer data-use information.
Apple authentication is integrated for supported devices.
iOS users have a platform-native login option.
Existing identities can be linked when the same account uses another provider.
Users can permanently delete their account and associated records, including provider revocation handling.
Account controls meet user and store expectations.
A valid Google/Firebase session is restored before showing sign-in after the app is closed.
Closing the app no longer signs the user out.
Timed Om playback now reaches the selected endpoint, plays the ending chant, and shows the completion message once.
Users receive the expected end-of-session confirmation.
Correct timer duration in media controls
The media source presented to Android uses the selected meditation duration instead of the full Om recording length.
A one-minute session displays as one minute on the lock screen.
Version 1.0.28 with version code 31 was built, signed, and validated as an Android App Bundle.
The corrected build is ready for internal testing upload.
Static analysis, tests, and bundle validation
Flutter analysis passed, 27 automated tests passed, and the AAB manifest/signature were verified.
The release has repeatable technical checks before testing.
Need to be done - received for Version 1 and resolved in this build
Timed Om meditation did not play the ending chant or show the completion message.
Timed playback now ends at the selected duration and runs the normal completion flow.
Automated tests and release build passed; confirm once on an internal-test device.
A one-minute meditation appeared as roughly three hours on the lock screen.
Android media metadata now exposes the selected timer duration instead of the source recording duration.
AAB metadata/signature verified; confirm the media notification on a physical Android device.
Closing and reopening the app logged the user out.
The app silently restores a valid Google/Firebase session before showing the sign-in screen.
Authentication flow compiles and tests pass; confirm session persistence through internal testing.
